## What's new in 0.5.0

- **Titles and summaries, on your Mac.** A local language model names new recordings after their content and, on request, writes a summary with key points, tasks and decisions. Use Apple Intelligence or a model you download under Settings → Recognition.
- **A calmer window.** Two columns instead of three: filter chips and a Folders menu above the list, recordings under date headings, and renaming right in the list.
- **See who spoke when.** A timeline above the transcript shows every voice on its own lane. Click it to jump there.
- **New live view and menu bar window.** A large clock and scrolling levels for "Me" and "Others" while you record. Start, pause and stop from the menu bar.
- **Dictation.** Voice commands for punctuation and line breaks in English and German ("comma", "new line" …), a small pill that moves with your voice, and an option to keep the text on the clipboard.
- **Folders named after titles.** Each recording's folder and audio files carry its title. When you change the storage location, Scripta offers to move your existing recordings.
- **Quiet microphones** show at a normal level while you record.
- **Settings** are now four panes: General, Recording, Recognition and Dictation.
- A new app icon.

**Before you update:** this version stores the library in a new format. Scripta makes a one-time backup first, but once 0.5.0 has opened your library, version 0.4.0 and earlier can't open it anymore.

## Install

Requires a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

1. Download the **.dmg** file below, open it and drag **Scripta** into **Applications**.
2. Open Scripta from your Applications folder. macOS says it can't verify the app. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to "Scripta was blocked". Confirm with your password or Touch ID.

You only need step 3 once per version: Scripta isn't notarized by Apple. See the [README](https://github.com/saibot-strg/scripta#readme) for details and how to use Scripta.
